name: The Bus That Has No Room
title: Fatal Commute!
description: the bus is full. you get on anyway. the bus is fuller. you can't move. the doors close. the bus is moving but the stops are wrong.
appearance: you see the bus. it's full. your body moves toward it anyway. the door opens. it shouldn't have.
thatMoment: the moment the door closes and your face is pressed against someone's backpack.

forgedEquipment.name: Commuter's Sixth Sense
forgedEquipment.desc: you always find a seat. even when the bus is empty. especially when the bus is empty.
